title: A product's treaty.json
description: What a product produces and consumes, the treaty release it pins, the treaty files it keeps copies of, and the go.mod files that require the treaty Go module instead. `treaty verify` checks it against the pinned release. v2 adds `goModules` to v1; every v1 document is a v2 document.

treaty.description: The release of @superjackfruitlabs/treaty-contracts this product checks against.

produces.description: Registry ids of the crossings this product owns.

consumes.description: Registry ids of the crossings this product reads.

vendored.description: Copies of treaty files kept in this repository, for languages that cannot read the npm package. Each must stay byte-identical to the pinned release; `treaty sync` rewrites them.

path.description: Relative to the repository root, inside it: no leading slash, no `..` segment, no backslash.

goModules.description: go.mod files in this repository that require the treaty Go module (github.com/SuperJackfruitLabs/treaty) at exactly the `treaty` release, in place of vendored copies. `treaty verify` checks each one requires that version and does not replace it.

items.description: Relative to the repository root, inside it, ending in go.mod.
